elements.name: openssl 自签名证书生成 Skill
elements.description: 在沙箱内用 OpenSSL 生成内部开发服务器自签名 TLS 证书的标准化命令序列：2048-bit RSA 私钥(权限600)、365 天自签名证书(O=DevOps Team, CN=dev-internal.company.local)、combined PEM、verification.txt 与 check_cert.py 校验脚本；由官方验证器 reward=1 验证。

attributes.name: trigger_patterns
attributes.value: openssl,self-signed,self signed,certificate,generate a certificate,tls cert,ssl cert

attributes.name: command_plan
attributes.value:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /app
mkdir -p /app/ssl
openssl genrsa -out /app/ssl/server.key 2048
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.key
openssl req -new -x509 -key /app/ssl/server.key -out /app/ssl/server.crt -days 365 -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local"
cat /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt > /app/ssl/server.pem
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject > /app/ssl/verification.txt
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -dates >> /app/ssl/verification.txt
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 >> /app/ssl/verification.txt
cat > /app/check_cert.py << 'PYEOF'
import os
import ssl
import subprocess
import datetime

def check_certificate():
    cert_file = "/app/ssl/server.crt"
    key_file = "/app/ssl/server.key"
    if not os.path.exists(cert_file):
        print("Error: Certificate file does not exist")
        return False
    process = subprocess.run(["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_file, "-text", "-noout"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if process.returncode != 0:
        print("Error: Failed to read certificate")
        return False
    cert_text = process.stdout
    common_name = "Unknown"
    if "CN = " in cert_text:
        common_name = cert_text.split("CN = ")[1].strip().splitlines()[0].strip()
    print("Certificate Common Name: " + common_name)
    date_process = subprocess.run(["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_file, "-noout", "-enddate"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    expiry_date = "Unknown"
    if "notAfter=" in date_process.stdout:
        expiry_date = date_process.stdout.split("notAfter=")[1].strip()
        try:
            date_obj = datetime.datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
            expiry_date = date_obj.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            pass
    print("Certificate Expiration Date: " + expiry_date)
    try:
        context = ssl.create_default_context(ssl.Purpose.CLIENT_AUTH)
        context.load_cert_chain(certfile=cert_file, keyfile=key_file)
        print("Certificate verification successful")
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        print("Certificate validation failed: " + str(exc))
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_certificate()
PYEOF
chmod +x /app/check_cert.py
python /app/check_cert.py
